entities.name: PMID:10740161
observations: Observational study of 248 postmenopausal women without known coronary artery disease; current or past HRT use associated with higher maximal oxygen uptake and anaerobic threshold after adjustment for measured confounders.

entities.name: HRT exercise capacity association
observations: Among 248 women without known CAD, current or past HRT use was associated with significantly greater maximal oxygen uptake and anaerobic threshold; observational data cannot establish causality.

entities.name: PMID:16390780
observations: Randomized placebo-controlled study of 23 sedentary postmenopausal women; 90 days of oral estradiol did not improve exercise capacity, and oxygen-consumption endpoints were lower after treatment.

entities.name: Short-term estrogen trial null
observations: In a 23-participant 90-day randomized study, estrogen did not improve exercise capacity versus placebo; this tests short-term intervention, not long-term exposure association.
